preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t representing the number of test cases, where 1 ≤ t ≤ 10⁴.

preconditions.expression: all(n.is_integer() and 2 <= n <= 3 * 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]])
preconditions.description: Each of the t test cases contains an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 3·10⁵) representing the length of the sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split())) == n for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All integers in each output sequence are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output sequence satisfies 1 ≤ aᵢ ≤ 10⁹.

postconditions.expression: all((max(map(int, line.split())) - min(map(int, line.split()))) ** 2 == sum(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each output sequence, the difference between the maximum and minimum elements equals the square root of the sum of the sequence.
